fixes.explanation: Good guess, baker, but Kiriath Jearim isn't the town Micah names. Micah 5:2 says, “But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah…” Now THAT is a small town. I've been in the back of a junk drawer with more people than some towns have, and nobody there was getting promoted. Yet the ruler over Israel comes out of Bethlehem Ephrathah.

Close, baker, but nobody's giving a speech in this verse. Micah 5:3 says the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel. I think that's the sound of a long wait finally ending. Not a microphone, not a podium, just people coming back. The word that fits is return.

I can see the thinking, baker, since the flock has been through a lot. But Micah 5:4 doesn't say they'll scatter. It says, “And they will dwell securely…” With this shepherd standing in the strength of the LORD, security is what the text promises.
